description.en: A Role of an Agent who transfers the ownership of the Procurement results (goods, services or works) to the Buyer. Additional information: A Role of an Agent that sells a Procurement Result (goods, services or work) to a Buyer. The Seller is bound by a Contract i.e. it has legal responsibility. The Seller may or may not be the same as the Supplier. The Seller may or may not issue the Invoice. The Seller may or may not be the owner of the credit owed by the Buyer.
